# matrices-ops.library: Lerp

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> Element-wise linear interpolation; `amount` is unclamped. Interpolating
> rotations this way shrinks them toward the chord — decompose first if the
> intermediate matrices must stay rigid.

## Signature

```plato
Lerp(self: Matrix3x2, matrix2: Matrix3x2, amount: Number): Matrix3x2
Lerp(self: Matrix4x4, matrix2: Matrix4x4, amount: Number): Matrix4x4
```

```plato
// Lerp endpoints, now derived from Add + Between rather than written per type.
Law_LerpAtZeroIsStart2D(a: Point2D, b: Point2D): Boolean
    => a.Lerp(b, 0.0).Distance(a) <= 1e-4;
```

### Line 112

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/matrices-ops.library.plato, line 112](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/matrices-ops.library.plato#L112).

```plato

    // Element-wise linear interpolation; `amount` is unclamped. Interpolating
    // rotations this way shrinks them toward the chord — decompose first if the
    // intermediate matrices must stay rigid.
    Lerp(self: Matrix3x2, matrix2: Matrix3x2, amount: Number): Matrix3x2
        => (self.Row1 + (matrix2.Row1 - self.Row1) * amount,
            self.Row2 + (matrix2.Row2 - self.Row2) * amount,
            self.Row3 + (matrix2.Row3 - self.Row3) * amount);
```

### Line 236

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/matrices-ops.library.plato, line 236](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/matrices-ops.library.plato#L236).

```plato
    // Element-wise linear interpolation; `amount` is unclamped. Interpolating
    // rigid transforms this way is not rigid — decompose and interpolate the
    // parts if that matters.
    Lerp(self: Matrix4x4, matrix2: Matrix4x4, amount: Number): Matrix4x4
        => (self.Row1 + (matrix2.Row1 - self.Row1) * amount,
            self.Row2 + (matrix2.Row2 - self.Row2) * amount,
            self.Row3 + (matrix2.Row3 - self.Row3) * amount,
            self.Row4 + (matrix2.Row4 - self.Row4) * amount);
```
